newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia tugs as thin Helsinki floats to new records.
newsitem.headline: Nokia tugs as thin Helsinki floats to new records.

text.p: Shares wafted in thin trade to a new all-time high close on the main indices on Monday, with the strong dollar helping Nokia and forestries and financials adding a push on an otherwise mixed market, brokers said.

The FOX index gained 0.88 percent to a life-high 1,172.31, scraping past its previous July 9 peak by four points, while the all-share HEX rose 0.97 percent to a record 3,417.01 points. The 459 million markka volume was meagre against recent levels.
"This looks fairly strong, but it all depends on how the U.S. market performs," one broker said, while others said a higher open on Wall Street for Nokia pointed to further upside.
With many domestic operators on summer holiday, brokers said a scarcity of sellers in combination with a normal level of overseas demand drove prices higher.
Nokia closed 9.20 markka higher at 428.20, coming off an intraday high of 431.00 which was just a few markka short of its all-time high 433.00 set last week.
Nokia's two shares together added more than five points to the FOX index's 10 point gains.
The dollar-markka exchange rate punched briefly through 5.3 and helped Nokia and forestries, in particular, brokers said.
UPM-Kymmene closed 0.50 higher at 135.00 in fair volume.
